2121970077171949832.en_summary: Patrick Moorhead: The take that many NVIDIA supply deals were a handshake with Jensen not a written contract is half right. Jensen made big calls in the room. CEOs of some of NVIDIA largest customers told me billion dollar commitments made on the spot. Risk to biggest deals overstated as they are on paper. NVIDIA disclosed $279B in supply and capacity commitments as of July up from $119B a quarter earlier driven by memory. $267B scheduled through fiscal 2029. NVIDIA became TSMC largest customer in 2025. Two biggest HBM suppliers tightening contracts so buyers cannot back out. Supply and roadmap mostly set for at least 18 months. Real exposure is next round not on paper and whether NVIDIA keeps committing at Jensen pace. Rivals will bid for whatever it does not. Colette Kress has been on calls reassuring suppliers. Tuesday $NVDA call her first as interim CEO is where she shows who makes the big calls now.
2121970077171949832.zh_summary: Patrick Moorhead：許多 NVIDIA 供應協議是與 Jensen 的握手而非書面合約的說法只對了一半。Jensen 確實在房間裡做出重大決定。一些 NVIDIA 最大客戶的 CEO 告訴我本週有十億美元級承諾當場做出。最大交易的風險被誇大了，因為它們是書面的。NVIDIA 披露截至七月有 2790 億美元供應和產能承諾，較前一季 1190 億美元上升，由記憶體驅動。其中 2670 億美元安排至財政 2029 年。NVIDIA 在 2025 年成為台積電最大客戶。兩大 HBM 供應商正在收緊合約，使買家無法退出。供應和路線圖至少在 18 個月內大多已設定。真正的風險是下一輪未書面的部分，以及 NVIDIA 是否繼續以 Jensen 的步伐承諾。對手將競標它所不承諾的。Colette Kress 一直在電話中安撫供應商。週二的 $NVDA 電話是她作為臨時 CEO 的第一次，她將展示現在誰做重大決定。
